meta.name: Ensure that Managed identity provider is enabled for Azure Event Grid Topic
meta.description: Ensure that Managed identity provider is enabled for Azure Event Grid Topic

evaluators.description: Every azurerm_eventgrid_topic must declare a managed identity. The identity block is a single-element list in change.after, so the path is identity.0.type and the requirement is a non-empty string; a topic with no identity block yields a severity-2 attribute miss and fails at error_tolerance 1.
